assets.title: Meadow Single-seat A-frame Swing
assets.description: Original static low-poly single-seat swing with two sage A-shaped end frames, four finite ground shoes, an ivory crossbeam, side ties and four diagonal knee braces. Two fixed metal beam collars and downward rope ferrules support long sand-coloured ropes; each divides through a lower ferrule into two short bridle ropes attached to four physical seat brackets on a single coral seat plank. The complete support route is real closed geometry and every named part connects to the four ground shoes. The seated central space, seat-to-frame and under-seat clearances are checked on actual triangles in this one rest pose. Five solid PBR materials; metre units, native Z up, front -Y and ground-centre origin. One independently reusable playground prop, distinct from the earlier pivoted seesaw, slide, picnic bench, clothesline and rigid footbridge. No person, extra scenery, textures or external dependencies. Fixed stylized game visual only: no swinging, rope dynamics, animation, load rating, anchoring, tipping resistance, fall-zone or entrapment compliance, engineering, playground or child-safety certification.
